```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_methylation_data.csv')
BRCA_methylation_data_original <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_sample_sheet.csv')
BRCA_sample_sheet <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirnmáme(wd), '/data/DMPs_10.000.csv')
DMPs_10.000 <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

Top 500 sifnifikante CpGs: 
```{r}
DMPs_500_cor <- DMPs_10.000[1:500,]
```

```{r}
significant_cpg_ids_500_cor <- rownames(DMPs_500_cor)
# Filtern und Sortieren der Zeilen in BRCA_methylation_original basierend auf den CpG-Ids in DMPS_10000
BRCA_methylation_filtered_500_cor <- BRCA_methylation_data_original[significant_cpg_ids_500_cor, ]

# Sicherstellen, dass die Reihenfolge der CpGs der Reihenfolge in DMPS_10000 entspricht
BRCA_methylation_filtered_500_cor <- BRCA_methylation_filtered_500_cor[order(match(rownames(BRCA_methylation_filtered_500_cor), significant_cpg_ids_500_cor)), ]
```

```{r}
#identische Bennung der Patient-ID  Bindestrich
colnames(BRCA_methylation_filtered_500_cor) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(BRCA_methylation_filtered_500_cor))
```

```{r}
# Herasufiltern des Alters aus BRCA_sample_sheet
age <- BRCA_sample_sheet$Days.to.birth

# Entfernen der Patienten, die keine Altersangabe haben
BRCA_sample_sheet_patients_age <- BRCA_sample_sheet[!is.na(BRCA_sample_sheet$Days.to.birth), ]

# Umrechnung der Tage in Jahre, um das Alter zu bestimmen (unter Berücksichtigung der Schaltjahre)
BRCA_sample_sheet_patients_age$age_in_years <- BRCA_sample_sheet_patients_age$Days.to.birth / 365.25*-1
```


```{r}
#Subset des Annotation Dataframes mit dem Type
#drop=FALSE behält die Dimensionen
tissue_types_age_Heatmap <- BRCA_sample_sheet_patients_age[,7, drop=FALSE]
```





## Correlation Heatmap between patients with age annotation
```{r}
# Pearson-Korrelation zwischen den Patienten ausrechnen
patient_cor_500_sigCpGs <- cor(BRCA_methylation_filtered_500_cor)

# Farbgebung für tumour tissue rot und für solid tissue blau
annotation_color <- list(
  Type = c(`Primary solid Tumor` = 'red', `Solid Tissue Normal` = 'blue'),
  Age = colorRampPalette(c("palegreen", "white", "darkblue"))(100))


# age Annotation 
age_annotation <- data.frame(Age = BRCA_sample_sheet_patients_age$age_in_years)
rownames(age_annotation) <- rownames(BRCA_sample_sheet_patients_age)

# Kombination der beiden Annotations:
combined_annotation <- cbind(tissue_types_age_Heatmap, Age = age_annotation)

# pdf erstellen 
pdf("correlation_heatmap_patients_with_age_annotation_500_sig_CpGs.pdf")

#Heatmap der Korrelation, geclustered mit complete linkage, Annotationen zum tissue Type
correlation_heatmap_patients_Top_500_age_annotation <- pheatmap(patient_cor_500_sigCpGs, 
         show_rownames = FALSE, 
         show_colnames = FALSE, 
         cellheight = 2, 
         cellwidth = 2,
    
         annotation_col = combined_annotation, 
         annotation_row = combined_annotation, 
         annotation_colors=annotation_color, 
         color = colorRampPalette(c("maroon4", "white", "darkgreen"))(100),
         legend_breaks = seq(30, 80, 10),
         legend_labels = seq(30, 80, 10)
)


dev.off()
print(correlation_heatmap_patients_Top_500_age_annotation)
         
```
